_comment: Proposed example only. Not loaded by any production code. Fields marked VERIFIED were confirmed directly against the current model.pkl/repository during the model-reconciliation forensic review (see validation/MODEL-RECONCILIATION.md); fields marked PLACEHOLDER require the project owner to supply a real, verified value before this manifest could be trusted as authoritative.
_model_sha256_status: VERIFIED — computed directly from the current model.pkl in this repository
_algorithm_status: VERIFIED — introspected from the loaded model object (sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier)
feature_names_hash: PLACEHOLDER — not computed by this task; recommend sha256 of the sorted, joined feature-name list so a future artifact swap can be detected
_training_dataset_status: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — this exact string is embedded in the current model.pkl as bundle['source']; the underlying raw EMBER-2018 corpus itself is not present in this repository and was not independently cross-checked
_training_sample_count_status: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — implied by bundle['source'] ("...(20000)"), not independently confirmed against a raw dataset file
class_distribution: PLACEHOLDER — not recorded anywhere in this repository for the EMBER run; the *preliminary* 830-sample dataset.csv is 796 healthy / 34 malicious, but that is a different dataset and must not be conflated with this field
_threshold_status: VERIFIED — bundle['seuil'] in model.pkl, and matches analyze.py's hardcoded SEUIL constant exactly
validation_protocol: PLACEHOLDER — the preliminary experiment used stratified 5-fold cross-validation (exp_seuil.py/exp_modeles.py, verified); no equivalent script for the final EMBER run exists in this repository to confirm the same protocol was used
recall: PLACEHOLDER — do not populate with either the preliminary (0.7647) or the final-report-claimed (0.941) figure without independent verification; see MODEL-RECONCILIATION.md
training_script_commit: PLACEHOLDER — this repository has zero git commits at any point in this engagement; a commit reference cannot currently exist
created_at: PLACEHOLDER — model.pkl's filesystem mtime (2026-07-23) is supporting evidence only, not a substitute for a recorded, signed creation timestamp
